verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Tabaarakal-ladhee biyadihil-mulku wa huwa alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Al-ladhee khalaqal-mawta wal-hayaata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu amalan wa huwal-azeezul-ghafoor
Al-ladhee khalaqa sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqan maa taraa fee khalqir-Rahmaani min tafaawutin farji'il-basara hal taraa min futoor
Thumma irji'il-basara karratayni yanqalib ilaykal-basaru khaasi'an wa huwa haseer
Wa laqad zayyannas-samaa'ad-dunyaa bimasaabeeha wa ja'alnaahaa rujooman lish-shayaateeni wa a'tadnaa lahum adhaabas-sa'eer
Wa lilladheena kafaroo birabbihim adhaabu jahannama wa bi'sal-maseer
Idhaa ulqoo feehaa sami'oo lahaa shaheeqan wa hiya tafoor
Takaadu tamayyazu minal-ghayzi kullamaa ulqiya feehaa fawjun sa'alahum khazanatuhaa alam ya'tikum nadheer
Qaaloo balaa qad jaa'anaa nadheerun fakadhdhabnaa wa qulnaa maa nazzala Allaahu min shay'in in antum illaa fee dalaalin kabeer
Wa qaaloo law kunnaa nasma'u aw na'qilu maa kunnaa fee ashaabis-sa'eer
Fa'tarafoo bidhanbihim fasuhqan li'shaabis-sa'eer
Innal-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratun wa ajrun kabeer
Wa asirroo qawlakum aw ijharoo bihi innahu aleemun bidhaatis-sudoor
Alaa ya'lamu man khalaqa wa huwal-lateeful-khabeer
Huwal-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda dhaloolan famshoo fee manaakibihaa wa kuloo min rizqihi wa ilayhin-nushoor
A'amintum man fis-samaa'i an yakhsifa bikumul-arda fa-idhaa hiya tamoor
Am amintum man fis-samaa'i an yursila alaykum haasiban fasata'lamoona kayfa nadheer
Wa laqad kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim fakayfa kaana nakeer
Awalam yaraw ilat-tayri fawqahum saaffaatin wa yaqbidna maa yumsikuhunna illar-Rahmaanu innahu bikulli shay'in baseer
Amman haadhal-ladhee huwa jundun lakum yansurukum min doonir-Rahmaani inil-kaafiroona illaa fee ghuroor
Amman haadhal-ladhee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu bal lajjoo fee utuwwin wa nufoor
Afaman yamshee mukibban alaa wajhihi ahdaa amman yamshee sawiyyan alaa siraatin mustaqeem
Qul huwal-ladhee ansha'akum wa ja'ala lakumus-sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idata qaleelan maa tashkuroon
Qul huwal-ladhee dhara'akum fil-ardi wa ilayhi tuhsharoon
Wa yaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul innamal-ilmu indallaahi wa innamaa anaa nadheerun mubeen
Falammaa ra'awhu zulfatan see'at wujoohul-ladheena kafaroo wa qeela haadhal-ladhee kuntum bihi tadda'oon
Qul ara'aytum in ahlakaniya Allaahu wa man ma'iya aw rahimanaa faman yujeerul-kaafireena min adhaabin aleem
Qul huwar-Rahmaanu aamannaa bihi wa alayhi tawakkalnaa fasata'lamoona man huwa fee dalaalin mubeen
Qul ara'aytum in asbaha maa'uukum ghawran faman ya'teekum bimaa'in ma'een
